Laws (Continuance in Force) Order 1977

CHIEF MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR'S ORDER 1 OF 1977
CHIEF MARTIAL LAW
ADMINISTRATOR'S ORDER 1 OF 1977
LAWS (CONTINUANCE IN FORCE) ORDER,
1977
1‑(1) This Order may be
called the Laws (Continuance in Force) Order, 1977.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.
